conbody.p: The STORE_HBO_STATS query option determines whether Impala populates the History-Based Optimization (HBO) cache with runtime statistics from completed queries.

When enabled, Impala collects actual cardinality statistics during query processing and stores them asynchronously in the HBO cache after the query completes. This asynchronous storage does not add significant latency to query execution. These saved entries provide the historical baseline used during future query planning when USE_HBO_STATS is enabled.

ul.li: Enable this option on queries to build historical stats for supported plan nodes (e.g., HdfsScanNode, AggregationNode, JoinNode).
Daemon startup flags such as hbo_max_runs_per_key and hbo_in_memory_backend_cache_size_bytes control the maximum historical runs and cache allocation for stored statistics.

conbody.p: Run the following command to instruct Impala to collect and cache statistics for subsequent queries in the session:SET STORE_HBO_STATS=true;
